sentences.transliteration: ishtareet tuffaa7 w mooz min as-soog.
tigdar tigashshir li haadi l-burtugaala?

sentences.arabic: نَاكُل بَطِّيخ كُل يُوم فِي الصَّيْف.
sentences.transliteration: naakul baTTeekh kull yoom fi S-Sayf.
it-tamr wit-teen a7la faakiha 3indi.
haada l-3inab 7aali marra.
haadi l-kummatra kharbaana, irmeeha.
gaTTi3 al-baSal w at-toom giTa3 Sagheera.
ni7taaj Tamaatim w khiyaar lis-salaTa.
7uTT al-baTaaTis fi l-forn saa3a.
tibgha na3naa3 fi sh-shaahi?

sentences.arabic: أُمِّي تِسَوِّي شُورْبَة عَدَس فِي الشِّتَا.
sentences.transliteration: ummi tisawwi shoorbat 3adas fi sh-shita.

sentences.arabic: مَا أَحِبّ البَاذِنْجَان، بَس أَمُوت فِي البَامْيَة.
sentences.transliteration: ma a7ibb al-baatinjaan, bas amoot fi l-baamya.
ni7taaj keeloo ruzz w shwayyat dageeg.
aakul al-3eesh bil-jibna w zayt az-zeetoon.
al-3iyaal yishrabu 7aleeb kull Sabaa7.

sentences.arabic: العَسَل مَع الزَّبَادِي كُوَيِّس مَرَّة لِلْفُطُور.
sentences.transliteration: al-3asal ma3 az-zabaadi kwayyis marra lil-fuToor.

sentences.arabic: حُطّ شْوَيَّة فُسْتُق وَلُوز مِن فُوق.
sentences.transliteration: 7uTT shwayyat fustug w looz min foog.

sentences.arabic: زِيد شْوَيَّة كَمُّون وَقِرْفَة عَلَى اللَّحْم.
sentences.transliteration: zeed shwayyat kammoon w girfa 3ala l-la7m.
tibgha dajaaj walla samak lil-3asha?

sentences.arabic: اِتْنِين شَاوِرْمَا، لَوْ سَمَحْت، بِدُون بَصَل.
sentences.transliteration: itneen shaawirma, law sama7t, bidoon baSal.

sentences.arabic: نِسَوِّي الكُفْتَة مِن لَحْم مَفْرُوم وَبَقْدُونِس.
sentences.transliteration: nisawwi l-kofta min la7m mafroom w bagdoonis.
ba3d al-3asha kalna kunaafa.

sentences.arabic: دَايِم نَاكُل زَيْتُون وَعِجَّة فِي الفُطُور.
sentences.transliteration: daayim naakul zaytoon w 3ijja fi l-fuToor.

sentences.arabic: اليَخْنَة تِبْغَالْهَا مِلْح وَفِلْفِل أَسْوَد زِيَادَة.
sentences.transliteration: al-yakhna tibghaalha mil7 w filfil aswad ziyaada.
